Quarterly letter, January 2026. Composite results for all discretionary client accounts for the periods ending December 31, 2025: 1 year 11.2% gross, 10.1% net; 5 years 7.8% gross, 6.7% net; 10 years 8.4% gross, 7.3% net (5- and 10-year figures are average annual returns). Net figures deduct a 0.50% annual advisory fee, the rate available to accounts above $5 million; most clients pay our standard 1.25% fee. Results include realized and unrealized gains and all trading costs. Past performance does not guarantee future results, and investments may lose value.
